case_envelope.common: id, rule (the REQ id the vector isolates), surface, construction {key, position, signature}, optional note
case_envelope.content_assertion: content_assertion: class, compact, expected {decode, verify}, attestor, expected_context (the profile.json expected block)
case_envelope.loopback: local_loopback_http: grant, compact, decode_local, decode_standard, envelope_local, issuer, request, nonce, target_uri (the profile.json fields inlined per case)
case_envelope.primitive: surface ed25519.verify_strict | ed25519.acceptable_public_key | ed25519.torsion_free; input {public_key, signature, message} base64url; expected {verdict}; the named key-only forgeries name their contract major in the rule id (REQ1 or REQ2) and carry raw_cofactorless: accept (the ungated cofactorless equation accepts the vector)
case_envelope.role_attestation: role_attestation: compact, decode, verify, attestor, subject, now (the profile.json fields inlined per case)
case_envelope.v1_shaped: families grant-verify, envelope, boundary-anchor, key-transition, anchored-export, jwk, jcs-utf8: the v1/v2 corpus case object (id, surface, class, input, expected) plus rule and major; input and expected are exactly that surface's v1/v2 shapes

class_mapping: v1-shaped cases: A-side and key-acceptance rejects are invalid_key; R, S and equation rejects are invalid_encoding; UTF-8 rejects are invalid_encoding; grants with a leading U+FEFF are invalid_algorithm (in alg) or invalid_claim (any other header value, payload value or member name)
rule: verify_strict(message, signature, public_key): 32-byte key and 64-byte signature; A and R canonical (y < p, and no sign bit when x = 0); neither A nor R of small order; S < L; then the cofactorless equation encode([S]B - [k]A) == R byte for byte
acceptable_public_key?(raw): 32 bytes, canonical, on the curve, not of small order
torsion_free?(raw): acceptable_public_key?(raw) and [L]A == O; a host requirement at enrollment, trust install and deny-list comparison, never on the verify path
torsion_note: accepted at verify; rejected by torsion_free?
verdict_source: pure BigInt arithmetic (strict decode, [8]P == O, cofactorless equation); no blocklist and no backend; cross-checked at generation against node:crypto behind the S1 gate
